entries.title: Blackmail and threats are criminal
entries.content: Using threats to demand money, sexual acts, silence, or any other compliance is a criminal offence (extortion / criminal intimidation). The victim can report to the police without first paying or complying. Victim Support Units and WOLREC can assist with reporting and protection.

entries.title: Forcing someone into prostitution or harmful acts
entries.content: Forcing another person into prostitution or other harmful sexual or economic activity is a serious offence under Malawian law. Survivors can seek police protection, medical care, and support services. They do not have to confront the person forcing them.

entries.title: Threats and intimidation
entries.content: Threatening a person with injury, exposure, or other harm in order to force them to do something is criminal intimidation. The person being threatened has the right to report to the police and seek protection.
